name_en: Nagasaki tempura — fish and vegetables in a sweetened batter, eaten without dipping sauce
summary_ja: 魚介や野菜に砂糖や酒を加えた小麦粉の衣をつけ、カリッと揚げるフリッターに近い料理。南蛮貿易のポルトガル人が食べていた味付き衣の揚げ物が原型とされ、衣自体に味があるため天つゆをつけずに食べる。
summary_en: Fish and vegetables are coated in a wheat batter sweetened with sugar and sake, then fried crisp into something closer to a fritter than standard tempura — said to descend from a seasoned-batter fry eaten by Portuguese traders, eaten plain since the batter itself carries the flavor.
source_title: 長崎天ぷら 長崎県
